All actions come from Quaternius Universal Animation Library 1 / 2 [Standard] (CC0, see assets/SOURCES.md); when changing actions, only change this file, and then run tools/build_character_anims.gd to repackage the animation library. The time units are seconds (the time in the action file, not the game time).
ref_speed = 动作本身一个周期走过的距离 ÷ 时长（米 / 秒，从 U: ref_speed = the distance traveled by the action itself in one cycle ÷ duration (meters/second, measured from the root bone displacement of UAL1_Standard_RM); playback speed = actual movement speed ÷ ref_speed, sandwiched between [scale_min, scale_max]. If it is lower than stop_below, it is counted as standing; if it is higher than run_from, it is replaced by running action.
出招动作与近战判定对齐：impact = 动作里剑最靠前、速度最快的时刻（从每帧: The move action is aligned with the melee judgment: impact = the moment in the action when the sword is most forward and fastest (measured from the right hand position of each frame). Play speed = (impact − starting point) ÷ Melee time from starting point to hit frame (combat/melee.gd TIMING). Heavy: Accumulate power first: push the action from 0 to wind_peak (raise it to the highest level) while holding it down, and then release it from wind_peak to impact.
